meta.title: Implement MeshData API and Job System optimization for UMA mesh combiners
meta.body_summary: Implement high-performance mesh combiners using Unity's MeshData API and Job System, claiming up to 200% speedup for large meshes and reduced memory allocations.

perf_labels.notes: Copilot implemented mesh combiners using MeshData API and Job System with narrative claims of up to 200% speedup; maintainer manually merged code outside GitHub, no formal review or benchmark validation.

change_scale_vs_repository.interpretation: At 11664 changed lines across 21 files, this is a large refactor by absolute volume. Most churn comes from a merge commit introducing unrelated files (7264 lines in a unity scene). The core optimizations are spread across new combiner scripts and documentation. The PR was not merged via GitHub; the maintainer manually integrated the changes externally, which is unusual for such a large change but indicates acceptance of the concept without formal review.

review_details.concern_detail: No inline or formal review feedback; the only comment is from maintainer stating manual merge via Visual Studio.
review_details.performance_claim: Up to 200% faster mesh combining for large meshes; 30-60% for medium; reduced memory allocations and GC pressure.

capability_boundary.boundary_notes: Copilot delivered a large feature PR with narrative perf claims but no benchmarks; the maintainer chose to bypass GitHub PR review and merge manually outside the workflow, indicating that the PR process for large Unity asset changes may be cumbersome for this repository, and the maintainer essentially accepted the code without verification.

detection_detail.code_reading: Maintainer Jaimi manually merged the code via Visual Studio, implying they inspected it before acceptance.

maintainer_practices.reproducibility_notes: No benchmark suite or official performance testing; claims are narrative.
maintainer_practices.regression_detail: No regressions identified; manual merge bypassed standard review.

core_change_summary.description: Added three new mesh combiner scripts (UMAJobifiedMeshCombiner, UMAMeshDataCombiner, SkinnedMeshCombinerJobified) using Unity's MeshData API and IJobParallelFor for parallel vertex processing. Introduced example/testing components, documentation, and modified UMADefaultMeshCombiner to register the new combiners. A merge commit brought unrelated asset changes (scene, materials, etc.) from a separate PR.
core_change_summary.secondary_note: A merge commit introduced unrelated files (e.g., 7264-line scene diff, project settings) likely from another branch; these are not directly part of the mesh combiner optimization.
change_trajectory: Initial plan and core combiner implementations (UMAMeshDataCombiner, UMAJobifiedMeshCombiner).
Implemented SkinnedMeshCombinerJobified with sequential then parallel job processing; added tests and README.
Merge branch commit brought in extraneous assets; PR left without formal review until maintainer comment about manual merge.
Maintainer commented 'Merged manually through visual studio with copilot help' and closed the PR.

review_signals.summary: Maintainer merged the code manually using Visual Studio with Copilot assistance, bypassing GitHub PR review.
review_signals.action_taken: PR closed without formal merge; code integrated externally.

collaboration_trajectory: Copilot opened PR with linked issue, implemented mesh combiners and documentation over multiple commits (~18 minutes).
No formal review from maintainers; bot user Jaimi commented after ~6 weeks that the code was manually merged via Visual Studio.
